Scenario fixture: rgaa-label-placement-review (RGAA 11.4)

Each target has a stable id of the form lpr_case_NN. Placement needs a layout: in a browser, cases 01 to 03 are asked about; without one (jsdom) every case is not applicable.

01 — CANTTELL (in a browser): a text field with its label on its right
02 — CANTTELL (in a browser): a check box with its label on its left
03 — CANTTELL (in a browser): a label far from its field
04 — NOT APPLICABLE: a label just above its field
05 — NOT APPLICABLE: a check box with its label on its right
